title: Thumb-thing's Cooking
notes: Red won the 'Cell's Kitchen' challenge and Kylie cut her thumb but kept cooking. Instead of a scored team service, Ramsay put Mya, Kylie, Sandra, Gabe, Miles and Miguel in a cook-for-your-life test, and Miles was sent home over his flank steak. Posted on the owner's approval with one independent source (Gold Derby). Mike's move from Blue to Red is recorded in ep 7.
